source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将出，静压难存
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC30 after EP02 SC29 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the nearly irreversible threshold into the next brink: Keshadu is essentially past suspicion and near declaration, Shisilang's fury is turning the scene unstable, Tuobaye is almost out of everything, and the white-clothed woman's restraint is reaching the point where it can scarcely still be called restraint.
title: 真相将出，静压难存

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC29 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC29 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将破，十四郎怒势已近失手，拓拔野几乎撑尽，白衣女子的静雷已至。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这一切进一步从不可逆转推进到几乎必然爆开。科沙度的判断已经接近宣之于口，十四郎的失控让局势更难维持，拓拔野则快没有任何缓冲。白衣女子的克制已经来到难以再称为克制的程度。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把这条线进一步逼到真正无法再维持假平衡的点，为明确出手或彻底揭露做最后铺垫。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and controlled until the actual source beat truly tips over; avoid premature spectacle.
Keshadu should feel nearly past the point of private suspicion and into active certainty.
Shisilang remains unstable and combustible from humiliation.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: near-declared truth, collapsing judgment, exhausted endurance, and failing restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
